free_tier.stated: Unlimited total quota (`user.videoQuota: -1`), 5 GiB per day (`videoQuotaDaily: 5368709120`). Registration open, no approval, no email verification.

egress.terms: Free — instance serves HTTP + WebTorrent/HLS; no egress meter. Peers can also seed via BitTorrent, offloading the host.

tooling: yt-dlp `PeerTube` extractor (verified present). Native REST API v1: `/api/v1/videos`, `/api/v1/users/me`, resumable upload via `X-Upload-Content-Length`. rclone has no native backend; a shell/curl wrapper is trivial.
chaining: cif.su alone is 5 GiB/day = ~1.8 TiB/year per account with no total ceiling. Multiply across the ~15 open-signup instances in the index and across accounts. hittube.fr is a flat 50 GiB with unlimited daily; arkcast.mycreationhaven.com is 5 GiB with unlimited daily.
limits_note: 5 GiB/day at cif.su is the binding constraint (a two-year fill for 3 TiB). Per-file cap is the global `video.file` size limit, not separately published; accepted containers include mkv/mov/avi/flac, so arbitrary-ish binaries can be wrapped. Some instances (diode.zone) are unlimited but approval-gated and not open-signup.
